## Highlights
### New
- Going back from the first page of a tab that a link, Command-click or the page itself opened closes that tab and takes you back to the tab that opened it. Tabs you open yourself, and saved or pinned tabs, work as before.
### Improved
- On Mac, Open Link in New Tab now leads a link's right-click menu, ahead of opening it in another Space, in Peek or in Split View.
### Fixed
- On Mac, Crest no longer quits when your disk is almost full and a site saves data. - On Mac, moving the pointer off the window's sidebar edge opens the hidden sidebar at once and keeps it open until you come back to the page.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
